sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Rouse Hill is located within the North West sector of Sydney which is an area of significant population growth. The Rouse Hill area currently has no public hospital or community health facilities available locally. Health Infrastructure is working in partnership with Western Sydney Local Health District to plan for the Rouse Hill Hospital to be built on a greenfield site near the Rouse Hill Town Centre. The service profile and Models of Care have been developed based on evolving demographics, advances in technology, and best evidence. The Rouse Hill Hospital will be fully integrated with other Western Sydney Local Health District (WSLHD) Hospitals including Westmead Hospital (the principal referral hospital for WSLHD) and Blacktown Hospital.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The Arts Curatorial Consultant for RHH will be responsible to coordinate planning, delivery and commissioning stages of artwork opportunities as outlined within the arts consultant brief. Summary below:

Planning Stage

- Milestone 1 - Consultation with Principal and relevant key stakeholders
- Milestone 2 – Arts Project Plan

Delivery Stage

- Milestone 1 - Preparation and management of creative briefs
- Milestone 2 – Long and shortlisting of artists
- Milestone 3 – Concept development proposals
- Milestone 4 – Artist selection and contracting

Commissioning Stage

- Milestone 1 – Design Development
- Milestone 2 – Detailed Design
- Milestone 3 – Fabrication and installation oversight
